reference.source: Parsons' Diseases of the Eye 23rd Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Iron ring cone, copper ring Wilson
reference.pathophysiology: Biomechanical stromal weakening lets intraocular pressure steepen thin cones while endothelial pump failure swells stroma each night (lids closed, evaporation nil) clearing as day evaporates; dystrophic gene products precipitate layer by layer in Bowman, stroma or Descemet.
additionalDifferentials: Keratoconus versus pellucid by cone position and crab claw
Fuchs versus pseudophakic bullous by guttae and history
Pterygium versus pinguecula by limbus crossing
additionalInvestigations: Systemic lipids, calcium and copper workup by ring
